notes.title: 5 Minute Mode Scoring Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We just released our latest update and it includes an improved scoring system for the 5 minute modes! We also fixed a couple of small bugs and did some optimisations.

Improved Scoring System
Now the scores should more accurately reflect performance

 Combos are shorter
 Money earned per the different dishes and meals has been adjusted
 Customer timers and satisfaction levels have been adjusted
 There are penalties for delivering a wrong order, cancelling a customer, hitting a customer and a customer leaving
 There are more customers being spawned
 The leaderboards will now display 19 names instead of 9 

 
Bug fixes and improvements:

 Optimised tutorials
 Fixed dialogues
 Fixed Steam achievement's progress being overwritten and not updating properly


We're continuously working on improving Rags to Dishes and are open to any and all feedback.

Now it's time for you to start competing for the high score!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38965206/a64e799b092d64b39985643db4dd7049494d2c3f.png

notes.title: Height Adjustment Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We just released our latest update and it includes the highly anticipated height adjustment! 

We added a button to the main menu called "Playspace Settings" that will take you to a calibration level.
In this level, you will be able to:

 Adjust the orientation: turn the room 90 degrees clockwise or anticlockwise.
 Adjust the height: move everything up or down.
 Adjust the scale: bring everything closer or further away from you. This will also make everything slightly smaller or bigger.


We also fixed several issues based on your feedback. 

Bug fixes and improvements:

 Added support for HTC Vive Cosmos.
 Added a controller type menu into the main menu. For Valve Index controller users, selecting the Index controller will fix the issue of the virtual hands not matching the angle of your own hands.
 Fixed the issue where some game assets retained their festive appearance after the festive season.
 Fixed an issue that was causing knights to remain in the level if they were active when a player pressed the retry button in the 5 minute mode.
 Fixed an issue where the shop tutorial arrows would stay in the level if the player exited the shop halfway through.
 Fixed an issue where the hand remains invisible if the start of game tutorial sign scroll is deleted while quill is held.


We're continuously working on improving Rags to Dishes and are open to any and all feedback!

Happy gaming :)

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

The holidays are sadly behind us and that means that the game is reverting back to it's normal look. There was a bug causing both the festive environments and the normal ones to be visible at the same time. It's been fixed now.

Should be a tiny update :)

notes.title: Online Leaderboards Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

We just released our latest update and it includes the highly anticipated online leaderboards! We also fixed several issues based on your feedback. Here is the full list of updates:

New features:

 Online leaderboards for the 5 minute modes
 Added a button to the main menu that allows you to change your orientation

Bug fixes and improvements:

 Fixed a bug where in some cases the controller haptics would not play
 Equalised intensity of haptics in kitchen interactions
 Reduced the prices of the first couple of upgrades for nobles and royals
 Lowered the XP required to unlock the first couple of recipes for nobles and royals

We're continuously working on improving Rags to Dishes and are open to any and all feedback.

Now it's time for you to start competing for the high score!

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

We just released our first patch. We aimed to fix issues based on your feedback. They are mainly quality of life improvements but here's the full list of fixes:


 Text and text formatting issues fixed
 Incorrect hand interaction fix
 Water pouring rate increased by 50%
 Fixed thumbstick mapping for right controller
 Dialogue UI scaled down and lowered
 Story character positions adjusted
 Fixed a bug that caused multiple tutorial arrows to spawn
 Base peasant oven cooking time decreased by 2 seconds
 Base peasant fire grill cooking time decreased by 1 second
 Inputting a name for your save file is now optional
 Fixed issue where haptics would be disabled when swapping between controllers while stirring oatmeal, grilling something on the fork, or whisking cake ingredients
 To confirm the deletion of a save file, you will now need to grab and hold the button for 2 seconds
 For new save files, stages will become available after the previous stage was completed, rather than after the completion of that stage
 Fixed an interaction where water poured into the oatmeal pot would become consumed by the ladle
 Added indication of completed stages when accessing a save file
 Fixed issue where hands would stay invisible at the end of a round if holding pottage
 Upgrades shop is available from the start
 In peasants, the prices for the first oven and grill have been halved. The XP required to unlock porridge and cheese has also been lowered
 Pressing the continue button when the end of day stats are being displayed will show all of them instantly. Pressing it a second time will continue to the in game menu
 Knights no longer have a time bonus when part of a meal is delivered
 Fixed a bug that caused the bird to be deleted after being hit. This also caused the customers to remain scared


Please know that we're working on bigger updates. In the meantime, we're open to any and all feedback! :)
